Class Hologram

java.lang.Object
com.atomictempest.holograms.api.Hologram
public final class Hologram extends Object
Floating text: one or more lines stacked upwards from its position (the last line is at the position). Each line is a Message, so it can be a translation key: every player reads it in their own language, and placeholders such as {lottery_pot} are filled in for each player. The text itself has no colour; the game draws names over entities in white.
